//: Hand-written, versioned policies (Story 9.2, Story 10.7, AD-18, NFR15, V7). Loaded by python -m dxp.gate.seed.
requires accepts only quote_found, supported, min_confidence and claim_checks; text is description and is never executed.
The claim checks themselves are decided by gate/claims.py (A06) from the source's own fields (overall_status, has_results) and checked quotes.
Never edit a seeded version in place: a change is a new version (bump version and _id).

policies.text: A change is filed only when its quote is found word for word in the source version it cites and the quote supports the value. For a report, this holds for every supporting quote and for both quotes of each established relationship.
policies.author: luis

policies.text: A sentence stating that an assay was performed, detected something, showed or produced results needs has_results true in the source, or a checked quote saying the assay was performed with results.
policies.author: luis

policies.text: When the source status is NOT_YET_RECRUITING or RECRUITING, or the trial is otherwise planned, the report must describe it as planned or ongoing.
policies.author: luis

policies.text: Evidence from cell lines or animals must be labelled preclinical.
policies.author: luis
